reader_summary.overview: We're counting down the top 5 episodes of 2025. At #2 is Ian Charles from Arctos Partners. Before founding Arctos alongside Doc O'Connor to dominate the sports investing sector, Ian spent his career creating liquidity solutions in private markets.

key_points.text: Arctos' second strategy goes back to his roots, providing solutions for GPs.
In all of his work, Ian is intensively research and data-driven.
